steps_items.text: Review PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. steps_items.heading: Submit PMI Application
steps_items.text: File your PMP application directly with PMI and remit the examination fee. Granite PM Academy staff can guide you through the submission process. Allow sufficient time for PMI to review your credentials before your exam date.

Granite PM Academy offers PDU-eligible courses to support your ongoing professional development in Clarksville's growing project-management community.
